title: Petronella Stomp variation
author: Tom Lehmann
problems: Row 7 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 6 "robins allemande right 1½ with next robins; larks slide left 1 place" doesn't work out: No couples meet new neighbors here.
Row 2 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 3 "balance & petronella · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 3 "balance & petronella · petronella" can't start from where the dancers are: A petronella of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 4 "balance & petronella to a left hand star · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 4 "balance & petronella to a left hand star · petronella" can't start from where the dancers are: A petronella of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 5 "star left 4 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
